name: What are common mistakes to avoid during DIY surface preparation?

mainEntity.name: What are common mistakes to avoid during DIY surface preparation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common DIY surface preparation mistakes include not cleaning thoroughly enough, leaving behind dirt, grease, or mildew; failing to sand properly, which can lead to poor adhesion; not repairing cracks or holes, allowing imperfections to show through; and skipping or improperly applying primer. Rushing the drying time between cleaning, repairs, and priming is also a frequent error. These shortcuts compromise the final paint finish and its durability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid common DIY surface preparation mistakes like insufficient cleaning, improper sanding, neglecting repairs, skipping primer, and rushing drying times, as these compromise the paint finish.
